routes.name: Benin e-Visa
routes.summary: Apply online on the official Benin e-Visa portal. Pay by Visa or Mastercard. Fees below come from a 2020 article, so check them before you pay.

other: Fees come from an official article posted 11 December 2020 and may have changed.
Visa types, validity and full requirements were not confirmed on the portal.
Some countries have reciprocal visa exemption agreements. The list was not read.

stay.note: Options are 30 days (single or multiple entry) or 90 days (multiple entry).

steps: Click the request button on the e-Visa homepage and fill in the form.
Confirm your email through the link you get.
Complete the four forms: personal, e-Visa, travel and passport details.
Pay by Visa or Mastercard with 3D Secure.
Track the request with the number emailed to you.
